title: A C40 core. Desaturation stages and branching end groups.
C40 골격, 탈수소화 단계와 말단 고리 분기.
intro: A composite, source-labelled map. The PSY product is 15-cis-phytoene; later desaturation cards show selected all-trans stage references, not every transient geometric isomer. CrtI systems and plant PDS/ZDS/isomerase systems differ. Hydroxylation and ketolation are parallel branches.
출처를 구분한 통합 지도이다. PSY 산물은 15-cis-phytoene이며 이후 탈수소화 카드는 선택한 all-trans 단계 참고 구조이다. 일시적인 모든 기하이성질체를 표시한 것은 아니다. CrtI와 식물 PDS·ZDS·isomerase 계는 다르며 수산화와 ketolation은 평행 분기이다.

edges.label: 2 GGPP - PSY / CrtB
edges.detail: A suitable phytoene synthase produces the C40 15-cis product. Some fungal CrtYB proteins combine this activity with lycopene cyclisation.

edges.label: CrtI stage / isomerisation
edges.detail: Desaturation-stage reference, with geometric isomerisation combined. The card depicts all-trans phytofluene; exact intermediate geometry and reaction order depend on the enzyme system.

edges.label: CrtI - stage reference
edges.detail: Increasing conjugation. The selected all-trans records are stage references, not a universal plant cis-isomer sequence.

edges.label: CrtI - stage reference
edges.detail: A further desaturation stage. Some CrtI enzymes stop at neurosporene rather than lycopene.

edges.label: CrtI - lycopene-forming
edges.detail: A suitable lycopene-forming CrtI completes the desaturation sequence. Endpoint specificity varies.

edges.label: LCYB / CrtY - beta ring
edges.detail: First beta-end cyclisation. Trivial gamma-carotene means beta,psi-carotene, not a gamma end group.

edges.label: LCYB / CrtY - beta ring
edges.detail: Cyclisation of the remaining open end supplies the beta,beta framework.

edges.label: LCYE - epsilon branch
edges.detail: Representative epsilon cyclisation. The delta-carotene record leaves the ring stereocentre unassigned; it is not a complete stereospecific product assignment.

edges.label: LCYB - beta end group
edges.detail: The beta,epsilon framework is produced by cyclising the open end. The alpha reference specifies 6-prime-R; this summary does not supply the missing stereochemical assignment in the delta record.

edges.label: Ring hydroxylases - stages
edges.detail: Several substrate-specific beta/epsilon-ring hydroxylations are summarised. This is not a single universal CrtZ reaction.

edges.label: hydroxylation
edges.detail: One β-ring hydroxylation, e.g. CrtZ/BCH depending on organism.

edges.label: hydroxylation
edges.detail: Hydroxylation of the second β-ring.

edges.label: ketolation
edges.detail: One keto group introduced, e.g. CrtW/BKT depending on organism.

edges.label: ketolation
edges.detail: Second keto group introduced.

edges.label: ketolation
edges.detail: Representative route where ketolase accepts hydroxylated rings.

edges.label: ketolation
edges.detail: Second keto group introduced. Mixed reaction orders can also occur.

edges.label: hydroxylation
edges.detail: Representative route where hydroxylase accepts ketolated rings.

edges.label: hydroxylation
edges.detail: Second hydroxyl group introduced.

edges.label: ZEP / VDE
edges.detail: Forward epoxidation uses ZEP; reverse de-epoxidation uses VDE and ascorbate in the reference cycle. These are distinct enzymes, not one enzyme running backwards.

edges.label: ZEP / VDE
edges.detail: Forward epoxidation uses ZEP; reverse de-epoxidation uses VDE and ascorbate in the reference cycle. These are distinct enzymes, not one enzyme running backwards.

edges.label: NXS / algal VDL1
edges.detail: Allene formation; enzyme identity varies by lineage. The all-trans neoxanthin record is shown.

edges.label: algal branch · summarized
edges.detail: A pathway-level connection in studied algae; not a universal single characterized enzyme.

edges.label: multiple branches + intermediates
edges.detail: Diatom fucoxanthin formation involves VDL2, ZEP1, CRTISO5 and xanthophyll acetyltransferase (XACT), with intermediates and alternate reaction orders omitted. The 2026 XACT study supports a multibranched pathway. This is not one direct reaction or a universal pathway for all producing lineages.
